content.text: In Zimbabwe, I built a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, without relying on Stripe or other platforms. The infrastructure I created, COREMERCH, not only allows me to sell digital products but also gives me full control over my business, including access to customer data and complete control over payments. When platforms like Stripe fail or restrict access, COREMERCH's infrastructure ensures that I can still operate my digital store, making it an essential solution for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments|creator]]s in countries with restrictive payment systems or economic sanctions. By using COREMERCH's infrastructure, I've eliminated the risk of being locked out of my own business and can focus on creating and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-presets-without-stripe-explained-digital-creators-stripe|Selling Presets]] digital products without any restrictions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's infrastructure works when platforms fail because it's designed as a sovereign commerce stack, giving creators full control over their business, including access to customer data and complete control over payments. Unlike traditional digital stores that rely on external platforms, COREMERCH's infrastructure is built on free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, making it a cost-effective and reliable solution for creators. By using COREMERCH's infrastructure, creators can eliminate the risk of being locked out of their own business and maintain control over their digital store even when platforms fail or restrict access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deployingCOREMERCH's infrastructure, you'll need a basic understanding of how to use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. You'll also need to create a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Once you have these tools set up, you can deploy COREMERCH's infrastructure and start selling digital products. With a little bit of setup and configuration, you can have a fully operational digital store that accepts crypto payments for free.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your Supabase database and configuring Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages to handle file delivery. You'll need to set up a webhook to automatically fire when a payment is confirmed on-chain, and configure your payment settings to use the recommended networks for low fees, such as BSC, Solana, or TRON. With these steps, you can set up a reliable payment and delivery pipeline that works seamlessly with your digital store.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live and processing your first transaction involves deploying your COREMERCH stack, testing your payment and delivery pipeline, and setting up your shop URL. You can deploy your stack in as little as 4-6 hours using the Sovereign Blueprint, and with a little bit of testing and configuration, you can start processing transactions and selling digital products. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can focus on creating and selling digital products without any restrictions or dependencies on external platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your COREMERCH infrastructure involves monitoring your performance, optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline, and adding more products to your digital store. With a little bit of monitoring and optimization, you can scale your digital store to meet growing demand and increase revenue. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to be highly scalable, making it an ideal solution for creators who want to grow their digital store without any restrictions or dependencies on external platforms.
